mentions.name: Midway
mentions.description: An app that finds direct flights to common destinations from different cities, helping people who live apart discover places they can both fly to directly. It accounts for seasonal flights and airline schedules.
mentions.problem: Finding common destinations between people living in different cities or continents is surprisingly difficult because of seasonal flights and airline schedules.
mentions.audience: People who live in different cities or on different continents and want to find a shared destination to meet up, such as friends or family.
mentions.source_excerpt: I started working on Midway a few months ago. This is an app to find direct flights to common destinations from different cities.
